subject: Scheduling: Bluegate Financial — Exec session slot & hotel block coordination
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluegate.com>, Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@bluegate.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Bluegate exec session — proposed dates and format

Hi Ellen / Luca,

Thanks again for committing time for the executive workshop. To keep things practical while protecting leadership schedules, we want to lock a single day of onsite sessions with a remote "bridge" for offshore attendees. Proposed windows (please pick 1 preferred + 1 backup):

- Option A: Tue, 13 Jan 2027 — 09:00–16:30 CET (onsite, with 09:00–10:30 kickoff open to remote)
- Option B: Wed, 14 Jan 2027 — 10:00–17:30 CET (onsite, remote bridges at 10:00–11:30 and 15:00–16:00)

High-level objectives: alignment on deployment timeline, SLA expectations, and a 60-minute design session for routing/fallback policies. We’ll provide a short agenda and venue/rooming suggestions once date confirmed.

Do you have a preferred hotel group for a room block? If you’d like, we can spin up a block with our travel partner (SaaS Travel). Also flag any dietary or AV constraints.

I’ve attached a draft agenda and the venue floor plan for room sizing.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Bluegate_Exec_Agenda_v1.3.pdf, Venue_Floorplan_Level2.png

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluegate.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@bluegate.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bluegate exec session — proposed dates and format

Hi Olga,

Thanks — both dates look workable. Preference is Option B (14 Jan) with Option A as backup. If we go 14 Jan please start no earlier than 10:00 CET — our CFO has a board call that morning.

Hotel: we prefer the Grand Alba chain (walking distance to the venue). Can you request a corporate rate and a small room block for 10 rooms (12–15 Jan)? We’ll confirm attendee list by next Wednesday.

Dietary: two vegetarian, one pescatarian. AV: please ensure the main room has a single HDMI spare and a Zoom Room camera with gallery view.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Partnerships, Bluegate Financial
ellen.park@bluegate.com
+44 20 7946 0xxx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: SaaS Travel Ops <ops@saastravel.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Bluegate — hotel block and AV logistics

Olga / Vanessa — looping in SaaS Travel to start the hotel block request and to propose a shuttle schedule (venue is 12 minutes from Grand Alba).

SaaS Travel, can you:
- Confirm a corporate rate & block for 10 rooms at Grand Alba (12–15 Jan) and include early arrival/late checkout options.
- Provide a rooming link (prefer group-managed booking) and an estimated per-night rate in EUR.
- Share transfer/shuttle pricing for a morning arrival window (08:30–10:00 CET) and an evening return (17:00–19:00 CET).

Vanessa — AV note: main room HDMI + Zoom Room camera. Can you confirm we can reserve the adjoining breakout with a single 65" display and a wired network drop for the design session? I’ll attach the venue floorplan to this thread.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Hotel_Block_Info.xlsx

From: ops@saastravel.com <ops@saastravel.com>

Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluegate.com>

Subject: Re: Bluegate — hotel block and AV logistics

Hi Marcus / Olga / Ellen,

We’ve provisionally held 10 rooms at Grand Alba (block code BG-REDWOOD-12JAN) pending guarantee. Estimated rate: €220/night (breakfast included). We can extend the hold until 2026-12-20; after that the hotel will release inventory. Rooming link and contract options here: https://bookings.saastravel.com/group/BG-REDWOOD-12JAN

Shuttle pricing: €250 per round trip (up to 16 passengers) for the day; we can schedule hourly pickups between 08:30–10:00 and returns 17:00–19:00. Will include shuttle manifest in the shared spreadsheet.

Please confirm the final attendee list and whether any rooms need individual billing vs. company billing.

Regards,
